blocks.html: Exhaust hood systems where required by Chapter 4 shall be provided with makeup air at a rate in accordance with Table 403.3.1.1. Such makeup air systems shall be equipped with a means of closure and shall be automatically controlled to start and operate simultaneously with the exhaust system.
